notes: Leave unavailable measurements null; never replace missing observations with zero.
Irrigation event dates and quantities remain in the audited irrigation-event API and should be referenced by field_id.
PILOT_001 must not be entered as water-balance truth because measured irrigation and field-water observations are absent.
Validation replays must set assimilation_enabled to false so observations remain independent truth.
Each field requires at least ten paired weather rows and ten paired field-water rows.
